parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries to return. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token for the next query. If this parameter is empty, no more results exist.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The resource ID. ResourceId and Tag cannot both be empty. At least one of ResourceId.N or (Tag.N.Key, Tag.N.Value) must be specified.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The information about instances and tags. ResourceId and Tag cannot both be empty. At least one of ResourceId.N or (Tag.N.Key, Tag.N.Value) must be specified.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The key of the tag to query. You can specify multiple keys. N is a positive integer.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The tag value. Valid values of N: 1 to 20.
